## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.
English and Korean are welcome.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include redacted screenshots
and note the Chrome version used. Explain any checks you could not run.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] English and Korean strings are updated if user-facing text changed.
- [ ] Permission, data handling, and auto reload changes are described, if applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private chat content, or unredacted conversation URLs are included.
